question: Owner 2026-10-31 '先补报警对照': inside the same 30-minute alarm windows, does entering the same coin at a random time with the same order geometry do as well as entering at its Monday 1.618 touch? Separates the 1.618 from 'buy any dip after a market-wide spike'.
single_variable: Entry time inside the alarm window: the signal's 1.618 touch vs every other 5m submission bar of the same symbol from the alarm bar to alarm+25 min; same percentage limit distance, scaled target, backstop, breakeven, confirmation, fees, slippage and sizing.
control_orders: all other submission bars with open in [alarm_ms, alarm_ms + 25 min], limit at c[j] * level / c[submit], target scaled by the same ratio, expires at the bar opening alarm_ms + 30 min; unfilled = no trade
matching: same symbol, side and 30-minute alarm window; 14-bar TR/close log2 quarter bucket recorded, bucket-matched subset reported (not a filter)
fees: Codex config maker 0.02 / taker 0.05 percent (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23); limit entries are maker, target exits maker, other exits taker plus 10bp slippage
parity: signal rows rerun in this native run must reproduce the 10-29 near30 hold fills (net, reason) per path
null_control: This is the matched random control itself: same symbol, same alarm window, same geometry and barriers. Episodes (alarms) are the independent unit; bootstrap over episodes.
known_limits: 25-coin threshold chosen in sample (2026-10-27); 122 of 129 alarms are long; controls can fill only inside the window; geometry copies the signal's submission distance, so wide touch-bar wicks give deep control limits.
